info.name: GitHub REST API Validation
info.description: Portable, read-only GitHub REST API test collection for the GitHub Documentation Lab (GH-008). Three unauthenticated GET requests exercise repository retrieval (200), an expected missing-repository response (404), and commit listing (200). Each request contains four post-response assertions (12 total). See docs/validation-log.md in the project repository for test observations, evidence, and limitations. No credentials are required or included.
